metadataRaw.title: How to Instantly Fix a Crick in Your Neck (PAIN TURNING HEAD)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help fix a crick in the neck.

If you're experiencing pain while turning or moving your head and neck, you may have a condition called a 'crick in the neck'.

This is when the muscles in the neck (and shoulder blade) regions become strained and inflamed, leading to stiffness and pain with movement.

The exercises in this video will help quickly loosen these tight muscles, offering more pain-free range of motion.

Each exercise works differently. They're going to target different muscles. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:40 Moose Hands
2:40 Edge of Bed Method
5:01 Trifecta Stretch
9:03 Towel Method
